D: Rick and Evie's young son puts on a cursed bracelet that sends them racing to the Oasis of Ahm Shere.
P: Serve the snacks when the double-decker bus chase starts in London.
S: O'Connell pork and sage sausage rolls
the O'Connell family home in London

Pork mince, onion, sage and breadcrumbs rolled in buttery puff pastry, egg washed and baked golden, served hot with brown sauce. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Halve 2 thawed puff pastry sheets, lay a sausage of filling along each strip and roll up, seam down. Brush with beaten egg, cut into 5cm pieces and score the tops. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve hot with brown sauce.
Watermelon wedges, figs, dates, pomegranate, mint and feta with lime
Watermelon cut into wedges with halved figs, dates and pomegranate seeds, scattered with mint and crumbled feta, finished with a squeeze of lime.
Mini pita wraps with falafel, tahini, pickled turnip and tomato
Small falafel tucked into mini pita with tahini, pickled turnip and tomato, wrapped in paper for the flight.
M: Butterflied lamb leg grilled with harissa, sliced over couscous with garlic yoghurt
Lamb leg butterflied, rubbed with harissa, garlic and cumin, grilled until charred, sliced with couscous and a yoghurt sauce.
London beef and stout pie with mash
Rick and Evie back home in England

Beef chuck braised in stout with onions and thyme for three hours, under a flaky puff lid, with buttery mash and minted peas. Toss 1kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 2 sliced onions, add the beef, 440ml stout, 250ml beef stock and 4 thyme sprigs. Cover and simmer gently for 3 hours, then cool slightly. Spoon into a pie dish, top with a puff pastry sheet, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and milk, and peas tossed with mint.
W: Layered filo with pistachio and cardamom, soaked in honey lemon syrup
Filo layered with butter, pistachios and cardamom, cut into triangles, baked at 180C for 40 minutes and soaked in honey syrup.
K: Iced karkadé with orange and mint
Chilled hibiscus tea with cinnamon, orange and mint over ice

Egyptian hibiscus tea brewed deep red with cinnamon, sweetened, chilled hard and poured over ice with orange slices and torn mint. Bring 1.5L water to the boil with 1 cinnamon stick, then take off the heat and add 40g dried hibiscus flowers. Steep for 15 minutes, strain and stir in 120g caster sugar until dissolved. Chill for at least 2 hours. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, a few orange slices and torn mint, pour over the karkadé and finish with a squeeze of orange.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 hour ahead, add lime last

steps.text: Cut the watermelon into wedges and lay on a big platter.
Add the figs and dates, then scatter with pomegranate seeds, mint and feta.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the chickpeas a day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Soak the chickpeas in plenty of water overnight, drain, then blitz with parsley, onion, garlic and cumin.
Shape into small balls and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C until dark golden.
Tuck into the pita with tahini, pickled turnip and tomato, then wrap in paper for the flight.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, grill fresh

ingredients.item: garlic clove, crushed, for the sauce

steps.text: Rub the lamb with the harissa, garlic and cumin.
Marinate for 2 hours.
Grill over high heat until charred outside and pink inside.
Rest for 15 minutes. Steep the couscous and mix the garlic into the yoghurt. Slice the lamb over couscous with the sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Rub up to 4 hours ahead, grill fresh

ingredients.item: garlic clove, crushed, for the sauce

steps.text: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh deeply and rub with the harissa, garlic, cumin and oil.
Leave for 20 minutes.
Grill cut side down over medium heat, then turn and cover until soft, 20 to 25 minutes.
Pour the boiling water over the couscous and chickpeas and cover for 5 minutes. Mix the sauce garlic into the yoghurt and serve the eggplant over the couscous with the sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Make a day ahead, rests for several hours

steps.text: Layer filo in a tin, brushing every sheet with the melted butter and scattering pistachios mixed with cardamom between every few layers.
Cut into triangles and bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden.
Warm the honey with the water and lemon juice and pour over the hot pastry.
Leave for several hours to soak.

steps.text: Bring the water to the boil with the cinnamon, then take off the heat and add the hibiscus. Steep for 15 minutes.
Strain and stir in the sugar until dissolved. Chill for at least 2 hours.
Fill four tall glasses with ice, orange slices and torn mint, pour over the karkade and finish with a squeeze of orange.
